new_entities.name: Topical niacinamide 5%
new_entities.description: Topical 5% niacinamide formulations used for skin-aging or barrier-related cosmetic effects.

new_entities.name: Clinical fine lines
new_entities.description: Clinician-graded or study-graded fine lines and early facial wrinkles.

edges.effect_quant: In a split-face 12-week trial of 50 women with facial photoaging, 5% niacinamide significantly reduced fine lines and wrinkles relative to vehicle. A larger 196-woman comparative study then found a niacinamide-based cosmetic regimen achieved wrinkle reduction benefits comparable to a 0.02% tretinoin regimen over 8 weeks.
edges.population: adult women with mild to moderate facial photoaging, fine lines, or wrinkle concerns using topical niacinamide-containing products
edges.mechanism: Niacinamide can improve barrier function, reduce transepidermal water loss, and alter skin texture and sallowness in ways that modestly soften the appearance of fine wrinkles over time.
edges.summary: Topical 5% niacinamide has a credible but modest anti-aging signal for fine lines. The benefit is smaller than the most aggressive retinoid claims, yet the evidence is decent and the tolerability profile is usually better than prescription tretinoin.
edges.caveats: This edge is about mild-to-moderate cosmetic improvement, not dramatic wrinkle reversal. Some supportive studies evaluate niacinamide as part of a broader regimen rather than as the only active ingredient.

evidence.notes: Niacinamide: A B vitamin that improves aging facial skin appearance.

evidence.citation: RobinsonLR et al 2010 Br J Dermatol
evidence.notes: A randomized, controlled comparative study of the wrinkle reduction benefits of a cosmetic niacinamide/peptide/retinyl propionate product regimen vs. a prescription 0.02% tretinoin product regimen.

evidence.citation: CostaA et al 2025 Curr Med Chem
evidence.notes: Topical Formulation with Niacinamide Combined with 5 MHz Ultrasound for Improving Skin Ageing: A Double-blind, Randomised, Placebo-controlled Clinical Study.
